Khushi ghar ki bani hoti hai.
Khushi jaanbujh kar khushi ka peecha karne se nahi milti.
Khushi shanti mein hai.
Apni umar doston se gino, saalon se nahi. Zindagi muskurahaton se gino, aansuon se nahi.
Azadi mann ki shakti hai.
Khushi jo chaho woh paane aur jo pao use chahne mein hai.
Jahan apne vichar kehne ki azaadi na ho, wahan azaadi bematlab hai.
Azadi asli hona hai.
Khushi neki ka inaam hai, khud neki nahi.
Khushi param aanand ka saar hai.
Khushi dil ki hansi hai.
Khushi aaram hai.
Khushi dhoop ki tarah hai.
Khushi ek adhyatmik masal hai.
Khushi ek itra ki tarah hai; doosron par chirke bina iski kuch boondein aap par bhi padti hain.
Khushi azaad aatma ka geet hai.
Khushi hi ekmatra bhala hai, khush hone ka waqt ab hai.
Azaadi avashyak hai.
Joy tyag ka inaam hai.
Azaadi samay ki mukti hai.
Azadi tark ka niyam hai.
Khushi safar ka tareeqa hai, manzil nahi.
Azadi ek chunav hai.
Azadi julm ka khatma hai.
Joy sadgi ki taraf wapsi hai.
Azadi insaan hone ka haq hai.
